official_source.source_type: official university final box score and recap

mechanistic_findings.evidence: NMSU rush yards 203 vs SHSU 11, first downs 21 vs 9; prior pregame adjusted NMSU rush EPA >0 and weak SHSU rush defense
mechanistic_findings.failure: Prematch rushing and defensive mismatch was recognized qualitatively but not reflected sufficiently in predicted ATS margin
mechanistic_findings.proposed_test: Add run pass interaction and adverse-script/tempo dominance distribution on strictly historical pregame inputs; paired holdout ATS and MAE validation before coefficient adoption

mechanistic_findings.evidence: SHSU 24 final points but only 17 offensive; 7 scored on blocked NMSU punt; NMSU offensive 30
mechanistic_findings.failure: The team-points PPD anchor pools offensive, defensive and special teams scores; last game demonstrates false attribution risk
mechanistic_findings.proposed_test: Derive offense-only PPD and opponent nonoffensive score incidence from verified PBP scoring events; fail closed if scoring team ambiguous

mechanistic_findings.evidence: Pre-kickoff model output reported historical NMSU third conversion ~0.051 and SHSU ~0.079, much lower than quoted season rates of roughly 0.41 and 0.364; verify definitions against provider box scores across teams
mechanistic_findings.failure: Third down labels may materially undercount conversions; integrated_scoring applies -0.08 capped PPD to both
mechanistic_findings.proposed_test: Validate third-down flags versus next-play same-drive down reset and official conversions before changing scoring; do not call low rates confirmed until independent verification

mechanistic_findings.evidence: Sam Houston 13 penalties for 118 yards, NM State 6 for 48; late Sam Houston offensive holding and personal fouls destroyed field-position gains
mechanistic_findings.failure: CFB penalty EPA missing; first-down penalty residual not enough to capture drive-shaping downside
mechanistic_findings.proposed_test: Add free PBP verified offensive penalty yards plus drive reset/first-down impact and fit only on prior games

mechanistic_findings.evidence: SHSU pass plays 81 and 53 accounted for 134 of 235 pass yards; blocked punt touchdown contributed 7 of 24 points
mechanistic_findings.failure: Outlier pass plays and unmodelled block special teams can boost score without sustaining series
mechanistic_findings.proposed_test: Separate team score from offensive score and decompose high-tail nonoffensive events without inventing deterministic future points

test_requirements: Paired margin MAE and ATS validation over adequate forward samples
Stress results against adverse rushing script and turnover-neutral case

pipeline_status.note: Official university final is verified; delayed source snapshot did not expose a final to the automated postgame path. Do not claim automated postgame calibration.
